speaker: Commissioner Gordon
opening: You wanted to discuss an authorization. Make it brief.

topics.label: The Commissioner alias
topics.question: Your old alias appears on the separately filed record. What did you authorize?
reply: My former operational names are not an invitation to browse restricted files.
If a signature needs verification, submit it through the proper channel. My office is not a shortcut around that channel.

topics.label: The insurance entry
topics.question: The questioned insurance entry has different typing characteristics from the document body. I need to verify the original entry.
reply: A discrepancy is a reason to request verification. It is not authority to question every restricted operation attached to it.
Put your findings in writing. I am not releasing additional records in this meeting.

topics.label: John's transport
topics.question: Alex believes John died, but no body was identified. Holly wants his remains found. Where are the follow-up records?
reply: I will not discuss the contents or disposition of restricted operational records with you.
You have an assigned recovery case. Attend to it. Speculation is not an additional assignment.

dismissal: That is enough. This meeting is over.
Return to your assigned case. Close the door on your way out. For once, leave something closed.
successText: Gordon refused to discuss the restricted records. His refusal does not prove that he caused the crash or altered the insurance entry.
